defs.closeSession: Close the current session (requires at least 2 sessions)
defs.resetSession: Reset all sessions (asks for confirmation first)
defs.tabRaw: Switch to the Raw Text tab
defs.tabStructured: Switch to the Structured List tab
defs.save: Save (Raw Text or Structured List, depending on the open tab)
defs.saveRowHint: Save the word being typed (when the Word/Meaning field is focused)

validation.duplicate: The same key cannot be used twice in one combination.
validation.needMainKey: The combination needs at least one main key (not Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Meta).
validation.tooManyMainKeys: Only one main key is allowed per combination.
validation.reserved: This combination is reserved by the browser or operating system and cannot be overridden.
validation.noModifier: No modifier key (Ctrl/Alt/Shift) — it may fire accidentally while you work outside input fields.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.description: All shortcuts in the app, grouped by page and then by component. Groups marked "Not opened" are inactive because that page or component has not been opened in this session — click to preview them, and open the page to use them.

editor.title: Edit shortcut
editor.conflictDescription: This combination is already used by <0>{{description}}</0> ({{group}}). Do you want to override it (the other feature loses its shortcut) or pick a different combination?
